title: DuckDB: add initial catalogs.yml v2 support for glue + iceberg_rest
body:
+15037930597 Summary

Add initial DuckDB support for `catalogs.yml` v2 so DuckDB projects can target shared Iceberg catalogs via:

- `glue`
- generic `iceberg_rest`

Design / implementation plan:
- https://gist.github.com/dataders/77f43fa299f8cecc75c2a1c35e2a141d

## Scope for the initial landing

- DuckDB v2 validation for `glue` and `iceberg_rest`
- DuckDB runtime resolution of selected catalogs
- DuckDB connection-init support for the required catalog `ATTACH` flow
- routing model database names to the attached DuckDB alias
- preserving the existing DuckLake / current DuckDB path

## Explicit non-goals for the initial landing

- DuckDB v2 support for `unity`
- local-files catalog support e.g https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core/issues/14512
- having `catalogs.yml` create or manage DuckDB secrets

## Notes

- `token_secret` should be treated as a reference to an already-existing DuckDB secret
- the current implementation/runtime plan is being tracked internally in `fs`: https://github.com/dbt-labs/fs/issues/9402
